regime_context: China A-shares narrative rotation shows a narrowing eligible universe (8 of 22 themes), led technically by AI Compute & Optics but with fragile momentum (mixed hurst, low breadth 0.12, durability at its 0.5 bar). Industrial Metals instead displays the strongest quality profile—trending, high durability (0.69), broad participation (0.54) and no crowding. However, backtest reveals that the absolute trend gate did not reduce drawdown here (mean-reverting tape), so any directional bias carries low confidence.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics leadership appears fragile: watch for durability falling below 0.4 and a weekly relative underperformance vs CSI 300 exceeding 3% over two consecutive weeks; if both confirm, the theme's leadership may be fading.

theses.subject: Industrial Metals
theses.thesis: Industrial Metals (512400.SS) combines the highest durability among leading themes with a trending hurst exponent and solid breadth, making it the most structurally sound leadership candidate. Durability, trend health, and breadth all point to a resilient theme, while the lack of crowding reduces squeeze risk.
theses.dissent: If macro data (e.g., China industrial profits or global PMIs) turn sharply lower, the mean-reverting character of this market could cause a rapid trend reversal that the durability signal fails to catch.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS closes below its 50-day simple moving average and the theme's durability reading falls below 0.5 before 2026-09-01.
